integrity: The proof combines the recent general meridional quotient lemma with the explicit classical meridional action in the finite Heisenberg subgroup. The modulo-six coinvariants are derived symbolically; finite computation is used only as a regression check.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns the odd-k doubly-null Kanenobu--Kazama torus-exterior family and positive twist exponents only. It identifies fundamental groups, not diffeomorphism or isotopy classes of the resulting four-dimensional objects.
title: All twist exponents for the odd Heisenberg torus-exterior family
